title: SCORE: Synthesis Cost and Output Returns Evaluator
summary: A benchmarking framework that measures the energy consumption of machine-learning data synthesizers against their privacy, fidelity, and utility returns. Its example custom synthesizer implementation instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a Metadata object detected from the training dataframe to generate synthetic tabular data as one of the evaluated synthesizers.
needs: Unclear if this SDV-based synthesizer file is actively run in the main benchmark loop or is a template example alongside others.
